evd_title: Inter-annotator agreement on citation accuracy labels was only kappa 0.18-0.31 in annotation phases 1-2
finding: Inter-annotator agreement on citation accuracy labels was only kappa 0.18-0.31 in annotation phases 1-2
P: Citations to first 30 of 100 PMC-OA biomedical reference articles (phases 1-2 of Sarol corpus)
O: Cohen's kappa: accuracy labels 0.18-0.31; evidence sentences 0.20 -> 0.37; citation context 0.96
S: Inter-annotator reliability sub-study within corpus annotation
